mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q01.stem: Hindi na alam ang chemical name matapos ilipat sa lalagyan. Ano ang gagawin?
options: Itigil ang paggamit at tiyakin ang ID/SDS sa responsable.
Hawakan ang kaunti nang walang PPE.
Mukhang tubig, kaya sa drinking container.
reasons: Smell/mixing ay maling ID/harmful-reaction risk.
Hindi mapipili ang hazard measures kung walang ID; tingnan ang label/docs, hindi hula.
Kahit kaunti, skin damage; huwag hawakan ang unknown chemical.
Maaaring clear hazardous liquid; drinking container ay accidental ingestion.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q02.stem: Basic on-delay 5 s, input off matapos 3 s. Output?
options: Hindi aabot sa setting, kaya hindi on.
Hold on after 3 s kahit input.
reasons: Timing mula sustained input, hindi off-hold time.
Basic input must continue 5 s; hiwalay ang retention ng modelo.
May delay, kaya hindi sabay.
Off sa 3 sbago 5 s, kaya nawawala ang kondisyon.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q03.stem: Tamang product/count, maling customer address. Bago ship?
options: Itago ang part number sa label.
reasons: Hindi tamang customer, kaya kulang shipping conditions.
Shock protection, hindi address fix.
Hindi corrected ang address at sira ID.
Kasama sa logistics ang address; hindi box strength/count ang lunas.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q04.stem: Ideal DC 6 V, desired 2 mA. Resistance?
reasons: 6×2 mA, hindi V/I.
V/I, hindi I/V; itugma units.
2 m Aginawang 2 A, kaya 1000 difference.
R=6/0.002=3000Ω=3 kΩ; convertm Ato A.
4 ms ginawang 4 s.
4 ms period, hindi 4 Hz.
Reciprocal 0.004 say 250, hindi 4000.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q06.stem: 0.01 mm micrometer, sleeve 8.5 mm, thimble 17. Dimension?
reasons: 8.5+17×0.01=8.67 mm; ihiwalay sleeve 0.5 at thimble multiplier.
Nakaligtaan ang 0.5.
17×0.1 ngunit 0.01 ang division.
17 div ay 0.17, hindi 0.017 mm.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q07.stem: Same volume material mass 3 times water. Specific gravity?
reasons: Ratio 3, hindi inverse o kg.
Density ratio, hindi density unit kg/m³.
Same volume, kaya mass ratio 3, dimensionless; walang mass/density unit.
Same volume condition; kaya hindi 3 kg mass.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q08.stem: Scale 1: 2, drawing written 80 mm. Manufacture length?
reasons: Hindi inverse-scale multiplication sa written.
Drawing size lamang ang scale; written 80 mm ang gawin.
Print scale affects ruler; kaya written ang una.
Re applying scale gives half ng specified 80.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q09.stem: Actual 600 min⁻¹, torque 3 N·m, P=2πNT/60. Approx output?
reasons: Kulang angular conversion/2π; humigit-kumulang sampung beses malaki.
2π×600×3/60=60π≈188.5 W; ihiwalay input/shaft dahil losses.
Hindi hinati sa 60 para rpm-to-second.

mfg1-electrical-mock-02-practical-q10.stem: Same shaft/hole nominal, ibang tolerances. Fit needs?
reasons: Kulang shaft sizes sa min/max clearance.
Hindi nominal ang max/min clearance/interference.
Clearance/interference/transition from combination, hindi nominal match.
Kailangan din hole limits para fit.
